of the Wind Crest...
going and making a kingdom on your own...
how you swagger... in this age!!

But that form of yours —
a skeleton... a monster?

To me, the great mage
Pikepike, of all people...

You dare call me a
monster! You, the red one!!

I am the bearer of the power
that truly rules this world...
chief of the Four Dark Element Generals...
I am the great mage... Pi! Ke! Pi! Ke!!
I don't get it, but I can't let a monster
wander around the knight order's building.
and prepare yourself! I'll kill you dead!

'whatever'! You rude thing!

purpose, I won't forgive you!!

ready for battle, now!
